thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: To validate if a binary tree is a valid binary search tree (BST), we can perform an in-order traversal and check if the values are in ascending order. During the in-order traversal, we keep track of the previously visited node's value and compare it with the current node's value.
